topics.title: Write about a successful person you admire.
topics.sample_essay: One successful person I admire is Magdi Yacoub. He is a famous Egyptian cardiac surgeon. He studied medicine at Cairo University. He performed many difficult heart surgeries and saved thousands of lives. He also founded a charity to help children with heart problems. I admire him because he worked hard to achieve his dreams. He proved that with passion and dedication, anything is possible.
